newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA'S KONKA H1 NET 164.6 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: CHINA'S KONKA H1 NET 164.6 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Konka Group Co Ltd had net profits of 164.60 million yuan on sales of 2.37 billion yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.
The company's per-share net was 0.45 yuan in the first half, the exchange said in a notice issued after the stock market closed.
It did not give any comparative figures or state whether the figures were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
Konka booked net profits of 143 million yuan for the first half of 1996 on sales of 2.03 billion yuan based on Chinese accounting standards.
The company, based in southern Shenzhen city, is the second biggest colour television maker in China.
